subject: general
question: Which of the following players is associated with badminton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**K Srikanth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Srikanth Kidambi** is an **Indian badminton player **who was born on 7 February 1993.
 
• **Kidambi**, a former world number one, received the **Arjuna award in 2015** and the **Padma Shri, **India's fourth-highest civilian honour, in 2018.
 
• He was the first Indian to play in the men's singles final of a** World Championship in 2021.**
 
• **Kidambi** was a member of the 2022** Indian men's Thomas Cup **team. After defeating Indonesia 3-0 in the championship match, the team went on to win the **Thomas Cup**, with **Kidambi triumphing over Jonatan Christie.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton**

 
 
• **Racquets** are used in the racquet sport of **badminton** to hit a **shuttlecock** through a net.
 
• The most popular versions of the game are "singles" (with one player per side) and "doubles," however it can also be played with bigger teams (with two players per side).
 
• While formal matches are conducted on a rectangular indoor court, **badminton** is frequently played as a recreational outdoor pastime in a yard or on a beach.
 
• The **shuttlecock** must land in the half of the court belonging to the opposing team in order to score a point.​
